items.titleEn: Predicting each organization's top prospect in 2028
bodyEn: With the Minor League regular seasons wrapping up this month, it’s tempting to say we’re already looking ahead to 2027. But in this case, we’re going one step beyond that.
Jump to: AL East | AL Central | AL West | NL East | NL Central | NL West

Back in March, we looked into our crystal balls to predict who the top prospect will be for every farm system on Opening Day 2028. Well, we’ve had a full season of baseball since then, along with plenty of transactions from trades and the Draft, so we’re taking a renewed look at the same predictions. Only 13 of our 30 picks are the same from the spring -- including one particularly sage selection involving this year’s Draft -- and 22 of the 30 come from the current MLB Pipeline Top 100 Prospects list.
AMERICAN LEAGUE EAST

Blue Jays: JoJo Parker, SS (No. 1/MLB No. 26)There’s no reason to move off Parker as the pick here, and in fact, his path as Toronto’s shortstop of the future might be even clearer now that Arjun Nimmala has been traded to the Angels. The 2025 eighth overall pick has met expectations by hitting .270/.399/.460 with 13 homers and 28 steals over 108 games at Single-A Dunedin and High-A Vancouver in his first full season, and there’s likely even more power coming with more strength training under the Jays’ tutelage and improved angles off the bat.

Orioles: Eric Booth Jr., OF (No. 1/MLB No. 40)He’s their top prospect now and there’s no reason to think the 2026 first-round pick won’t be at the start of the 2028 season. The No. 7 overall pick in the 2026 Draft was the second high schooler taken, after Grady Emerson, signing with the O’s for right around slot ($7.33 million). He was one of the fastest runners among the prep players in the class and will work on refining his base-stealing and reads and routes in center field. He has an unusual setup at the plate, but has 20-20 potential offensively.

Rays: Grady Emerson, SS (No. 1/MLB No. 10)We slotted in Emerson as the Tampa Bay pick in March with the thinking that the Rays would jump on him if he was available at No. 2 overall in the Draft, and that’s exactly what happened. The left-handed-hitting shortstop still has work to do before we can say we nailed the pick for 2028, but he has a bevy of tools at his disposal now that he’s in the pros. Some amateur scouts believe he could be a potential plus-plus hitter from the left side with above-average power, and his defensive abilities (quick hands, good fundamentals, plus arm) all draw great reviews at a premium position too.

Red Sox: Justin Gonzales, OF (No. 2/MLB No. 79)After winning the 2024 Carolina League batting title (.298) as the second-youngest qualifier (age 18) in the Single-A circuit, Gonzales has encored by boosting his home run total from from four to 19 while slashing .270/.388/.459 in 103 games between High-A and Double-A. Signed for $250,000 out of the Dominican Republic in 2024, he's bigger than his listed 6-foot-5 and 210 pounds and owns some of the best bat-to-ball skills, raw power and arm strength in the system.

Yankees: Dax Kilby, SS (No. 2/MLB No. 86)Though Kilby has been hampered by hamstring injuries in his first full pro season, he still has stood out with his advanced approach at the plate and 20-20 upside. A supplemental first-rounder from a Georgia high school in 2025, he batted .261/.448/.435 with four homers, 12 steals and more walks than strikeouts (39 versus 31) in 32 games in Single-A at age 19.
AMERICAN LEAGUE CENTRAL

Guardians: Juneiker Caceres, OF (No. 4/MLB No. 82)While Caceres' $300,000 bonus ranked just eighth in the Guardians' 2024 international class, he has proven to be the best prospect from that crop. The Venezuelan has a knack for barreling balls and hits them harder than most teenagers. He missed time with an oblique injury this season but hit .301/.409/.484 with 11 homers in 74 games between two Class A levels.

Royals: Angeibel Gomez, OF (No. 3/MLB No. 84)In an ideal world for Kansas City, this is a tough call for the club by 2028 with Gomez and 18-year-old righty Kendry Chourio each having legit claims to their prospect throne. Signed for $2.9 million in January, Gomez is on a rocket ship after hitting .361/.467/.653 with nine homers and a 19/28 K/BB ratio over 47 games in the Dominican Summer League in his debut season. His power has played in games quicker than most 17-year-olds, and his bat-to-ball skills from the right side have been better than advertised. Gomez could jump several dozen places in the Top 100 by ‘28 if this level of performance carries over stateside.

Tigers: Bryce Rainer, SS (No. 3/MLB No. 48)There’s plenty of volatility in Rainer’s profile, but the ceiling is cathedral high for the 2024 11th overall pick if he puts it together. The left-handed slugger comes with at least plus raw power, and his speed and defense at shortstop (aided by a 70-grade arm) both should be above-average at peak. That’s a potential four-tool star at a premium spot. However, he’ll need to improve his contact after striking out in 35.2 percent of his plate appearances this season for High-A West Michigan, and as his swing changes throughout 2026 indicate, that will likely be a point of focus heading into ‘28 too.

Twins: Vahn Lackey, C (No. 2/MLB No. 19)There’s an outside chance that Lackey, the No. 3 overall pick in this year’s Draft, will graduate to the big leagues by the start of the 2028 season, but we’ll predict that the responsibilities of catching will keep him a rookie for at least the start of the year. His solid pro debut, including hitting well with High-A Cedar Rapids, does help put him on a bit of a faster track, and the super-athletic backstop has the chance to be a plus hitter with plus power while providing excellent defense behind the dish.

White Sox: Cole Prosek, 3B/C (No. 5)One of the best high school hitters in the 2026 Draft, Prosek signed for a well over-slot $3,247,500 in the second round out of the same Magnolia Heights (Senatobia, Miss.) program that produced Cooper Pratt. With his quick left-handed stroke and impeccable sense of timing at the plate, he has the upside of a plus hitter with solid power. He'll make his pro debut in 2027.
AMERICAN LEAGUE WEST

Angels: Hayden Alvarez, OF (No. 3)The guess here is that newly acquired Arjun Nimmala, and 2025 first-rounder Tyler Bremner, both in Double-A currently, will be in Los Angeles by this point. Alvarez is a dynamic outfield prospect who had an outstanding age-19 season while reaching High-A. He could eventually be a plus hitter with a solid approach (.289 average with a .391 OBP combined this year), getting on base to use his speed (53 steals). He’s starting to grow into more impact, with 49 extra-base hits.

Astros: Kevin Alvarez, OF (No. 1/MLB No. 80)The youngest batting qualifier (age 18) in Single-A this year, Alvarez ranked fourth in the Carolina League with 40 extra-base hits while slashing .261/.343/.429 with 17 steals in 99 games. He makes better swing decisions and has more advanced skills than most players his age, and one scout compared his setup and swing path to Kyle Tucker's.

A’s: Johenssy Colome, SS (No. 5)Leo De Vries’ torn labrum will keep him out for eight months, so there’s a chance that his express train to the big leagues will be delayed long enough to make him eligible. But we’re still so bullish on his talent that he’ll come back better than ever and graduate, leaving the top spot for Colome, the A’s top 2026 international acquisition ($4 million bonus). After the 17-year-old infielder posted a .956 OPS in the Dominican Summer League for his debut, the A’s are very excited to see what he does when he comes stateside next season.

Mariners: Felnin Celesten, SS (No. 4/MLB No. 50)The transition to Double-A has been a little bit tough for Celesten, but he’s still posted a combined OPS of .821 with 16 homers, 25 steals and a 112 wRC+. He’ll need to keep refining his approach and continue to show he can get the ball in the air a bit more, but there’s still so much ceiling for him to reach, and he’s shown glimpses since missing his debut in 2023 and much of 2024 with injuries.

Rangers: Gio Rojas, LHP (No. 3/MLB No. 96)The Rangers managed to grab the 2026 Draft's best left-hander -- college or high school -- with the 16th overall pick. A star on the showcase circuit and with Team USA, the Florida high school product is a projectable and athletic 6-foot-4, 195-pounder who already commands a fastball that reaches 98 mph and owns a low-80s sweeper that's a wipeout pitch at its best. He'll pitch in his first pro game in 2027.
Subscribe to the MLB Pipeline Newsletter
NATIONAL LEAGUE EAST

Braves: Eric Hartman, OF (No. 1/MLB No. 42)Could Hartman graduate before 2028? It’s not impossible to imagine after the way he’s burst on the scene the last two seasons since being a 20th-round pick out of the Canadian high school ranks in 2024. An aggressive jump to Double-A this year has come with expected bumps, but he’s mashed 26 homers and stolen 54 bags, making him the only 20-50 player in the Minors.

Marlins: Aiva Arquette, SS (No. 3/MLB No. 63)The best college position player and seventh overall pick in the 2025 Draft, Arquette is more physical (6-foot-5, 220 pounds) and has much more power than most shortstops. He missed the start of this season recovering from core muscle surgery and also lost time to a left thumb injury, but has hit .267/.320/.454 with 11 homers and 20 steals in 60 games between High-A and Double-A. The former Oregon State star moves well for his size and showcases plus arm strength at short.

Mets: Elian Peña, SS (No. 3)The Mets signed Peña for $5 million as their top international addition of 2025, and they’ve been supremely aggressive with him in his second pro season by skipping him over short-season ball with an opening assignment to Single-A St. Lucie and a promotion to High-A Brooklyn in mid-August – all before his 18th birthday. He held his own in the Florida State League with a decent mix of bat-to-ball skills across different pitch types and angles along with top-level EVs for his age, and those could even stand to improve if he uses this as more of a foundational year. An even stronger age-19 showing in 2027 could be a springboard for the Top 100 and future place atop the Mets’ rankings.

Nationals: Eli Willits, SS (No. 1/MLB No. 4)The only thing that may knock Willits out of this spot is if he makes DC by the second half next year and graduates in ‘27 instead of ‘28. He did just get promoted to Double-A at 18 years old after all. The 2025 No. 1 overall pick has come as advertised in his first full season, marrying good swing decisions with good contact levels for his age. His current level of power will be challenged as he ascends to the upper Minors, unless he adds more pop deeper into his teens, but his hit tool, speed and high-quality defense make him a high-floor player.

Phillies: Francisco Renteria, OF (No. 3/MLB No. 81)The Phillies have been buzzing since they signed Renteria for $4 million at the start of this year’s international signing period. And while we have to take DSL stats with the commensurate grains of salt, the toolsy outfielder did nothing but add excitement by slashing .379/.470/.682 with 11 homers and 24 steals in 53 games. His 176 wRC+ leads ALL Minor Leaguers at any level, helping lead to DSL MVP honors.
NATIONAL LEAGUE CENTRAL

Brewers: Luis Peña, SS (No. 2/MLB No. 21)The 2026 season has been a tough pill to swallow for Peña, with multiple injuries and health issues limiting him to 67 games between High-A Wisconsin and Double-A Biloxi, the latest being a broken leg suffered on Saturday. The hope here is that these will be isolated issues in a rough year, and 2027 can be a healthier campaign in the upper Minors. When he’s on the field, Peña can show the makings of an electric talent with good contact skills, impressive speed and budding power. The presences of Brice Turang and Cooper Pratt and likely ascension of Jesús Made in ‘27 should allow him the time to build on that foundation.

Cardinals: Alexander Frias, OF (No. 4)It’s looking likelier that Rainiel Rodriguez could push his way to the Majors in time to graduate as a 20-year-old next year, so we turn to another current teen in this spot in Frias. Acquired from the Brewers at this year’s Trade Deadline, Frias brought wicked bat speed from the left side to the Cardinals system, and he’s already hit plenty of screamers in the Arizona Complex League and two Single-A circuits in his age-18 season. With just average speed and at least plus arm strength, he might be ticketed for right field long-term, but the power upside is clearly good enough to work in such a corner. It could be a lot of fun to see what jump he can make after a full spring of working with Cardinals coaches and instructors, given the hitting jumps elsewhere in the system of late.

Cubs: Josiah Hartshorn, OF/1B, (No. 1/MLB No. 39)Hartshorn signed for a sixth-round-record $2 million as a California high schooler in 2025 and has looked like a steal in his pro debut, batting .289/.411/.528 with 23 homers and 16 steals in 122 games between two Class A levels at age 19. He ranks fourth in the Minors with 110 RBIs and has demonstrated uncommon swing decisions and power for a teenager.

Pirates: Edward Florentino, OF (No. 2/MLB No. 35)It’s been a little bit of a weird year for Florentino, starting off by being slowed out of the gate with an ankle injury. The 6-foot-4 left-handed hitter only hit .235 and struck out 25.7 percent of the time, though he offset that with a 16 percent walk rate and 27 total homers (24 with Greensboro placed him fourth in the High-A South Atlantic League at age 19), so we’re still very bullish about his offensive potential while sticking in center field.

Reds: Justin Lebron, SS (No. 3)The Reds have options -- Alfredo Duno might not graduate and Steele Hall is very talented -- but let’s take a big swing here with Lebron, who the Reds never thought would be available at No. 18 overall. He had the best overall set of tools in the class, but really struggled during his junior year at Alabama, especially in SEC play. It’s a small sample size during his pro debut, but we’re taking his .940 OPS with High-A Dayton over 23 games as a good sign that he very well might turn out to be the steal of the first round of the 2026 Draft.
NATIONAL LEAGUE WEST

D-backs: Ryder Helfrick, C (No. 2)Arizona added to a burgeoning group of catchers by taking the Arkansas backstop 15th overall in July, and with Gabriel Moreno in the bigs and fellow Top 5 prospect Carlos Virahonda already in Double-A, the D-backs won’t have to push Helfrick any more aggressively than his development allows. He already draws plus grades for his receiving, framing and arm strength, and he has good raw power from the right side. His hit tool will need the most work after struggles versus non-fastballs in school, but even if it ends up as a 45 rather than a 50, the rest of the toolset can carry him.

Dodgers: Eduardo Quintero, OF (No. 3/MLB No. 20)Part of the Dodgers' seemingly limitless supply of outfield prospects, Quintero trained as a catcher in Venezuela but became a full-time center fielder after signing for $297,500 in 2023 because the club wanted to make the most of his athleticism and offensive upside. The MVP and prospect of the year in the Single-A California League in 2025, he slashed .309/.455/.495 with 45 extra-base hits and 44 steals in 111 games while leading the High-A Midwest League in batting and on-base percentage this season. He should have solid to plus tools across the board once he's fully developed.

Giants: Josuar Gonzalez, SS/2B (No. 1/MLB No. 17)On this week's Pipeline Podcast, we declared Gonzalez our favorite to rank as the game's top prospect entering the 2028 season. Signed for $2,997,500 out of the Dominican Republic as the top position player in the 2025 international class, he batted .351/.447/.544 with 26 extra-base hits and 21 steals in 61 games between Rookie ball and Single-A as an 18-year-old making his U.S. debut. He comes with solid raw power and well above-average speed, not to mention switch-hitting ability and smooth defense at shortstop.

Padres: Kruz Schoolcraft, LHP (No. 2)There have surely been some bumps in Schoolcraft’s first full season, specifically in the control department with 57 walks in 79 1/3 innings with Single-A Lake Elsinore. However, patience was always going to be required with a 6-foot-8 southpaw who was a two-way player as recently as last year. Schoolcraft can still sit 93-96 mph with his heater and get ample whiffs with his slider and changeup. With another offseason of prep work, he could squeeze out more consistent velocity and tighten up the control to take up the top-prospect mantle left by Ethan Salas’ expected graduation next summer.

Rockies: Ethan Holliday, SS (No. 1/MLB No. 25)There’s still a lot to learn for Holliday, the No. 4 overall pick in the 2025 Draft, starting with cutting down on the swing-and-miss (28.3 percent K rate during 2026). But the power was already showing up (.557 SLG, .952 OPS), and he’ll get a chance to start over again after playing in just 33 games before a stress fracture in his left foot ended his first full season.
items.titleZh: 预测各支球队在2028年的头号潜力新秀
items.summaryZh: 本文盘点并预测了各支MLB球队在2028年开幕战时的头号潜力新秀。多伦多蓝鸟部分由JoJo Parker当选。
bodyZh: 随着小联盟常规赛在本月接近尾声，人们很容易觉得我们已经在展望2027赛季了。但这一次，我们要再往前看一步。
跳转至：美联东区 | 美联中区 | 美联西区 | 国联东区 | 国联中区 | 国联西区

早在今年3月，我们就曾通过水晶球预测过，各球团农场系统在2028年开幕战时的头号潜力新秀会是谁。自那以后，我们已经经历了一个完整的棒球赛季，期间也伴随着大量的交易与选秀运作，因此我们对当时的预测进行了重新评估。在我们30个选秀顺位中，只有13个与春季时的选择保持一致——其中包括对今年选秀的一次极具先见之明的选择——而30名人选中有多达22人来自目前MLB Pipeline的Top 100潜力新秀榜单。
美国联盟东区

多伦多蓝鸟：JoJo Parker，游击手（第1名/大联盟第23名）没有任何理由不继续将Parker视为这里的头号人选；事实上，随着Arjun Nimmala被交易至天使，他在未来成为多伦多游击手的道路反而变得更加清晰了。这位2025年首轮整体第8顺位的新秀在首个完整小联盟赛季中效力于单A达尼丁和高阶A温哥华，在108场比赛中交出了.270/.399/.460的打击三围，并有13支本垒打和28次盗垒，完全符合预期。在蓝鸟教练组的指导下进行更多力量训练并优化挥棒击球角度后，他未来有望展现出更强的怪力。

巴尔的摩金莺：Eric Booth Jr.，外场手（第1名/大联盟第40名）他目前就是金莺的头号潜力新秀，而且没有理由认为这位2026年首轮新秀在2028赛季开始时不会继续稳居此位。作为2026年选秀大会的整体第7顺位，他是继Grady Emerson之后第二位被选中的高中生球员，并以接近原定顺位奖金（733万美元）的金额与金莺签约。他是该届备战球员中跑速最快的选手之一，未来将继续打磨盗垒技术以及在中外场对球路的判断和跑动路线。他在打击区的站姿有些不同寻常，但在进攻端具备打出20-20（20轰20盗）潜力的天赋。

坦帕湾光芒：Grady Emerson，游击手（第1名/大联盟第10名）我们在3月份将Emerson列为光芒的预测人选，当时的想法是如果他在选秀大会以整体第2顺位掉落时，光芒一定会毫不犹豫地将其拿下，而这也确实成了现实。这位左打游击手在成为2028年的确凿人选之前还有一些工作要做，但自从踏入职业赛场以来，他已经拥有了一套丰富的各项身手。一些业余球探认为，他有望成为一名具备左打优势、拥有高于平均水平力量的强打者，同时他在高级别守备位置上的防守能力（敏捷的双手、扎实的基本功、出色的臂力）也收获了极高的评价。

波士顿红袜：Justin Gonzales，外场手（第2名/大联盟第79名）在2024赛季以单A联赛第二年轻的符合资格打者（18岁）身份夺得卡罗拉纳联赛打击王（.298）之后，Gonzales在高阶A和双A总计103场的比赛中，将本垒打数从4支飙升至19支，打击三围为.270/.388/.459。他在2024年以25万美元从多米尼加共和国签约入队，其实际体型比登记的6尺5寸、210磅还要壮硕，并且拥有全系统中最顶级的击球掌控能力、纯力量以及臂力。
纽约洋基：Dax Kilby，游击手（第2名/大联盟第86名）尽管Kilby在职业生涯首个完整赛季中受到了腿筋伤势的困扰，但他先进的选球策略以及20-20的潜力潜能依然令他脱颖而出。作为2025年从佐治亚州高中通过补充首轮被选中的新秀，他在单A以19岁的年龄出战32场比赛，交出了.261/.448/.435的打击率，伴有4支本垒打、12次盗垒，且保送数多于三振数（39次保送对比31次三振）。
美国联盟中区

克利夫兰守护者：Juneiker Caceres，外场手（第4名/大联盟第82名）尽管Caceres的30万美元签约金在守护者2024届国际球员中仅排在第八位，但他已经证明了自己是该批新秀中最好的潜力股。这位委内瑞拉小将有着极强的核心击球能力，击球初速比大多数同龄青少年都要强。本赛季他曾因斜肌受伤缺席了一段时间，但在两个不同级别的A级联赛共74场比赛中，依然打出了.301/.409/.484的打击三围和11支本垒打。

堪萨斯城皇家：Angeibel Gomez，外场手（第3名/大联盟第84名）对于堪萨斯城来说，如果要在2028年做出选择将是一道幸福的难题，因为Gomez和18岁的右投手Kendry Chourio都对农场头号宝座虎视眈眈。Gomez于1月以290万美元签约，在其职业生涯首个赛季的加勒比海夏季联盟（DSL）中出战47场，交出.361/.467/.653的打击率、9支本垒打以及19/28的三振保送比，犹如火箭般窜升。他的长打能力在比赛中展现的速度超过了大多数17岁球员，并且他从右侧打击区展现出的击球掌控能力也超出了预期。如果这种表现能延续到美国本土，Gomez在2028年之前有望在百大新秀榜上跃升几十位。

底特律老虎：Bryce Rainer，游击手（第3名/大联盟第48名）Rainer的球员档案中存在着许多不确定性，但如果这位2024年整体第11顺位的新秀能够完全兑现天赋，其上限将高得惊人。这位左打强打者至少拥有高于平均水平的纯力量，其速度和游击防守（在70分臂力的加持下）在巅峰期都应能达到高于平均水准。这是一个在重要守位上潜在的四拍子明星。不过，他需要改善自己的接触球能力，他在本赛季为高阶A西密歇根出战时吞下了高达35.2%的三振率，正如他整个2026年挥棒动作的调整所显示的那样，这很可能也将成为他迈向2028年时的重点关注方向。

明尼苏达双城：Vahn Lackey，捕手（第2名/大联盟第19名）作为今年选秀大会的整体第3顺位，Lackey有极小的概率在2028赛季开始前就升上大联盟，但我们预测捕手位置的重任将至少让他在赛季初保持新秀身份。他稳健的职业首秀——包括在高阶A锡达拉皮兹的不俗打击表现——确实帮助他进入了一条相对较快的晋升轨道。这位超级运动能力出众的捕手有机会成为一名具备出色打击率和强力本垒打威胁的打者，同时在捕手防线后方提供卓越的防守。
芝加哥白袜：Cole Prosek，三垒手/捕手（第5名）作为2026年选秀中最好的高中打者之一，Prosek在第二轮以远超顺位建议值的3,247,500美元签约，他出自曾培养出Cooper Pratt的同一所密西那州塞纳托比亚木兰高地高中。凭借其敏捷的左打挥棒动作以及在打击区无可挑剔的时机感，他拥有成长为一名具备强力打击能力的优秀选手的潜质。他将在2027年迎来职业首秀。
美国联盟西区

洛杉矶天使：Hayden Alvarez，外场手（第3名）这里的推测是，新近通过交易加盟的Arjun Nimmala以及2025年首轮新秀Tyler Bremner目前都身处双A，届时应该已经在洛杉矶站稳脚跟了。Alvarez是一名充满活力对外场潜力新秀，他在19岁赛季表现出色并一路打到了高阶A。他最终可能成长为一名具备稳健战术体系的强打者（本赛季综合打击率为.289，上垒率为.391），能够频频上垒以发挥其速度优势（53次盗垒）。他开始展现出更强的打击破坏力，共敲出了49支长打。
休斯敦太空人：Kevin Alvarez，外场手（第1名/大联盟第80名）作为今年单A最年轻的符合资格打者（18岁），Alvarez在卡罗拉纳联赛中以40支长打排名第四，在99场比赛中交出了.261/.343/.429的打击三围和17次盗垒。他比同龄的大多数球员拥有更好的击球决策和更成熟的技术，一位球探甚至将他的站姿和挥棒轨迹与Kyle Tucker进行了对比。

运动家：Johenssy Colome，游击手（第5名）Leo De Vries的肩唇撕裂伤将让他缺阵八个月，因此他通往大联盟的快车有可能会被延迟足够长的时间，从而保住他的新秀评选资格。但我们依然极其看好他的天赋，相信他会满血回归并成功毕业，从而将头号位置留给运动家2026年最大手笔的国际签约球员Colome（400万美元签约金）。在这位17岁内野手在加勒比海夏季联盟交出.956的OPS完成职业首秀后，运动家非常期待他在下赛季来到美国本土后的表现。

西亚图水手：Felnin Celesten，游击手（第4名/大联盟第50名）过渡到双A对Celesten来说有点艰难，但他仍然交出了.821的综合OPS，并伴有16支本垒打、25次盗垒以及112的wRC+（加权得分制造值）。他需要继续打磨自己的选球策略，并持续证明自己能够将球打得更高一些，但他依然具备巨大的发展上限，自从2023年以及大部分2024年因伤缺阵以来，他已经屡屡展现出自己的天赋闪光点。

得克萨斯游骑兵：Gio Rojas，左投手（第3名/大联盟第96名）游骑兵在2026年选秀中以整体第16顺位成功摘下了这届比赛中最好的左投手——无论是来自大学还是高中。作为球探巡回赛和美国代表队的明星，这位来自佛罗里达州的高中出品拥有一副极具潜力的运动型身材（6尺4寸、195磅），其直球球速已经能够达到98英里/小时，并且拥有一颗球速在80英里/小时左右、状态绝佳时极具毁灭性的扫荡滑球（sweeper）。他将在2027年迎来自己的首场职业比赛。
订阅 MLB Pipeline 新闻通讯
国家联盟东区
亚特兰大勇士：Eric Hartman，外场手（第1名/大联盟第42名）Hartman能否在2028年之前毕业？自从2024年通过第20轮从加拿大高中崭露头角并在过去两个赛季迅速崛起之后，这种可能性并非完全无法想象。今年激进地跳级到双A带来了一些意料之中的成长阵痛，但他已经轰出了26支本垒打并盗垒54次，这使他成为小联盟中唯一的“20-50”球员。

迈阿密马林鱼：Aiva Arquette，游击手（第3名/大联盟第63名）作为2025年选秀大会中最好的大学位置球员和整体第7顺位新秀，Arquette比大多数游击手更加强壮（6尺5寸、220磅），并拥有更恐怖的力量。由于从核心肌肉群手术中恢复，他错过了本赛季初的比赛，后来又因左拇指受伤缺阵了一段时间，但在高阶A和双A总计60场的比赛中，他依然打出了.267/.320/.454的打击率，外加11支本垒打和20次盗垒。这位前俄勒冈州大明星以其体型而言移动相当敏捷，并在游击防区展现出极佳的臂力。

纽约大都会：Elian Peña，游击手（第3名）大都会以500万美元签下了Peña，将其作为2025年最重要的国际签约引援。在其职业生涯的第二个赛季中，大都会对他极其激进，跳过了短赛季联盟，直接将他安排在单A圣露西开局，并在8月中旬将其升至高阶A布鲁克林——这一切都发生在他18岁生日之前。他在佛罗里达州立联盟中站稳了脚跟，面对不同类型的球路和角度展现了不错的击球掌控能力，同时其击球初速也达到了同龄人的顶级水准；如果他将今年视为夯实基础的一年，这些数据未来甚至还有望进一步提升。在2027年迎来更强势的19岁赛季，可能会成为他杀入百大新秀榜并稳居大都会农场排名榜首的跳板。

华盛顿国民：Eli Willits，游击手（第1名/大联盟第4名）唯一可能把Willits挤出这个位置的原因，是他如果在明年下半年就打上华盛顿并在2027年提前毕业，而不是等到2028年。毕竟他刚刚在18岁的年龄被晋升至双A。作为2025年的状元秀，他在首个完整赛季中完全兑现了预期，将出色的选球决策与同龄人中极佳的接触球水平完美结合。随着他向小联盟高级别迈进，他目前的本垒打火力将受到严峻挑战，除非他在十几岁的后期能够开发出更多长打能力，但其出色的打击技巧、速度和高质量的防守使他成为一名下限极高的球员。

费城费城人：Francisco Renteria，外场手（第3名/大联盟第81名）自从在今年国际签约期开始时以400万美元签下Renteria以来，费城人上下就一直对充满期待。尽管我们必须带着客观的眼光来看待加勒比海夏季联盟（DSL）的数据，但这位充满天赋的外场手在53场比赛中交出了.379/.470/.682的打击率、11支本垒打和24次盗垒，用实际行动点燃了球迷的热情。他高达176的wRC+在所有级别的小联盟球员中名列第一，这也帮助他赢得了DSL年度最佳球员的荣誉。
国家联盟中区

密尔沃基酿酒人：Luis Peña，游击手（第2名/大联盟第21名）对Peña来说，2026赛季是苦涩的一年，多次伤病和健康问题将他的出场数限制在高阶A威斯康星和双A比洛克西之间总共67场比赛，最近的一次则是周六遭遇的断腿伤情。这里的希望是，这些伤病只是艰难一年中的孤立事件，2027年他能够在小联盟高级别赛事中迎来一个更健康的赛季。当他踏上球场时，Peña能够展现出令人惊叹的天赋雏形，具备出色的接触球技巧、惊人的速度以及逐渐显现的长打威力。Brice Turang和Cooper Pratt的存在以及Jesús Made在2027年的潜在晋升，应该会给他足够的时间在这个基础上继续成长。

圣路易斯红雀：Alexander Frias，外场手（第4名）看起来Rainiel Rodriguez更有可能在明年以20岁之龄提前晋升并毕业，因此我们将目光转向了该位置的另一位未满二十岁的新星Frias。作为在今年交易截止日从酿酒人交易而来的强援，Frias将极为凶悍的左打击球速度带到了红雀农场，在其18岁的赛季中，他已经在亚利桑那复杂联盟和两个单A联盟中敲出了大量劲射安打。凭借着平均水平的速度和至少高于平均的臂力，他长期来看可能会被定性为右外场手，但其本垒打上限显然足以支撑他在这个角落位置立足。鉴于红雀农场其他地方最近在打击实力上的提升，看看他在与红雀教练和指导员合作整整一个春训之后能取得多大的飞跃，将会是一件非常有趣的事情。

芝加哥小熊：Josiah Hartshorn，外场手/一垒手（第1名/大联盟第39名）Hartshorn在2025年以加州高中生身份打破了第六轮选秀签约金纪录，以200万美元签约，并在其职业生涯首秀中被证明是一笔极其划算的交易。他在19岁时效力于两个A级联赛的122场比赛中，打出了.289/.411/.528的打击率，外加23支本垒打和16次盗垒。他以110个打点在小联盟中排名第四，并展现出了极其罕见的击球决策能力和青少年时期少有的强悍力量。

匹兹堡海盗：Edward Florentino，外场手（第2名/大联盟第35名）对Florentino来说这是有些诡异的一年，开局时因脚踝受伤而放慢了脚步。这位6尺4寸的左打者打击率仅为.235，且吞下了25.7%的三振率，不过他通过16%的保送率以及总计27支本垒打（其中在格林斯伯勒打出24支，在19岁时高阶A南大西洋联赛中排名第四）弥补了这一缺陷，因此我们依然极其看好其进攻潜力，并认为他会继续留守中外场。

辛辛那提红人：Justin Lebron，游击手（第3名）红人拥有很多选择——Alfredo Duno可能不会毕业，而Steele Hall也非常有天赋——但让我们在这里对Lebron进行一次豪赌，红人此前从未想过他会在第18顺位掉落。他在同届新秀中拥有最好的综合身手，但在阿拉巴马大学的第三年遇到了不小的挣扎，特别是在东南部联盟（SEC）的比赛中。虽然他在职业首秀中的样本较小，但我们在高阶A代顿出战23场比赛交出的.940 OPS，被我们视作一个好兆头，他很有可能成为2026年选秀首轮中捡到的最大宝藏。
国家联盟西区

亚利桑那响尾蛇：Ryder Helfrick，捕手（第2名）响尾蛇在7月以整体第15顺位选中了这位来自阿肯色大学的捕手，进一步充实了其不断壮大的捕手阵营。随着Gabriel Moreno已经在大联盟站稳脚跟，且同为前五大潜力新秀的Carlos Virahonda已经在双A效力，响尾蛇完全不需要比其自身发展节奏更激进地去催促Helfrick。他在接球、偷好球（framing）以及臂力方面已经获得了高水平的评价，并具备从右侧打击区轰出纯力量的潜力。他在学校面对非直球时曾遭遇过挣扎，其打击技巧将是需要下最多功夫去打磨的环节，但即便最终这一项评分为45而非50，他其余的各项技能也完全足以支撑他在大联盟立足。

洛杉矶道奇：Eduardo Quintero，外场手（第3名/大联盟第20名）作为道奇似乎取之不尽的外场潜力新秀阵容的一部分，Quintero在委内瑞拉时曾接受过捕手训练，但在2023年以297,500美元签约后转为全职中外场手，因为球队希望最大程度地发挥他的运动能力和进攻上限。作为2025年单A加利福尼亚联赛的MVP和年度最佳潜力新秀，他在111场比赛中交出了.309/.455/.495的打击三围，拥有45支长打和44次盗垒，并在本赛季领跑高阶A中西部联赛的打击率和上垒率。一旦完全成熟，他有望在各方面都具备扎实到高于平均水平的身手。

旧金山巨人：Josuar Gonzalez，游击手/二垒手（第1名/大联盟第17名）在本周的Pipeline播客节目中，我们宣布Gonzalez是我们心目中最被看好在2028赛季开始时荣登全联盟头号潜力新秀的人选。作为2025年国际球员中排名最高的位置球员，他以2,997,500万美元从多米尼加共和国签约，在新人联盟和单A总计61场的美国首秀赛季（18岁）中，交出了.351/.447/.544的打击率，伴有26支长打和21次盗垒。他拥有扎实的纯力量以及远超平均的速度，更不用说他具备左右开弓的打击能力以及在游击防区的流畅守备。

圣迭戈教士：Kruz Schoolcraft，左投手（第2名）Schoolcraft在首个完整赛季中无疑遇到了一些成长阵痛，特别是在控球方面，他在单A雷克埃尔西诺登板的79.1局中投出了57次保送。然而，对于一位直到去年还是投打二刀流、身高6尺8寸的左投手来说，耐心从一开始就是必需的。Schoolcraft依然能够投出93-96英里/小时的直球，并利用其滑球和变速球制造大量的挥空。通过另一个休赛期的备战，他有望挤出更稳定的球速并收紧控球，从而接过Ethan Salas预计在明年夏天毕业后留下的头号潜力新秀衣钵。
科罗拉多洛矶：Ethan Holliday，游击手（第1名/大联盟第25名）作为2025年选秀的整体第4顺位，Holliday仍有许多东西需要学习，首当其冲的就是减少挥空率（2026年的三振率为28.3%）。但他强大的长打火力已经开始显现（.557的长打率，.952的OPS），在因左脚疲劳性骨折导致首个完整赛季仅出战33场就提前报销之后，他将有机会重新出发。

items.titleEn: Okamoto hits 30th HR to propel Blue Jays in hunt for Wild Card spot
bodyEn: WEST SACRAMENTO -- In nearly every answer he gave after leading the Blue Jays to a 4-2 win over the Athletics on Tuesday at Sutter Health Park, Kazuma Okamoto’s message was clear: Toronto isn’t done yet.

While Okamoto acknowledged he met a personal goal by hitting his 30th home run of an impressive rookie season, he continued to point to what comes next: 16 crucial regular-season contests that will determine his club’s postseason fate. With Tuesday’s win, the Blue Jays (73-73) remain one game out of the final American League Wild Card spot.

“Definitely, it’s great to get to 30 in my first year, but we’ve still got a few games to go here,” Okamoto said through interpreter Yusuke Oshima. “I want to flip the switch and focus on the games moving forward.”

Okamoto is certainly flipping the switch in September, batting .333 (9-for-27) with a 1.009 OPS in seven games during the month. He followed up a 423-foot solo home run in Monday night’s 6-5 walk-off loss with another dinger on Tuesday, going back to back with Josh Smith to begin the second inning. He tied White Sox infielder Munetaka Murakami for the most home runs by AL rookies in 2026, just one behind Cincinnati’s Sal Stewart for the Major League lead.

With the solo blast to left off A’s starter Jack Perkins, Okamoto recorded the 10th season by a player born in Japan to reach the 30-homer plateau. Shohei Ohtani has done it six times, Murakami has done so in 2026, Seiya Suzuki hit 32 homers last season, and Hideki Matsui created the club with 31 dingers in 2004.
“It’s a pretty cool milestone, 30,” Blue Jays manager John Schneider said. “Pretty good list he just joined of Japanese players there.”

Maybe it’s unsurprising that Okamoto would slug 30 dingers in his first MLB season: He did so for six straight years, from 2018-23, with the Yomiuri Giants of Nippon Professional Baseball, racking up 248 career home runs in NPB.

Okamoto has struggled at times in the Majors -- including for much of the second half -- but his recent surge has been promising. Schneider pointed to the right-handed slugger’s final at-bat in the ninth inning, in which Okamoto wasn’t quite on a slider at the bottom of the zone but still drove it 310 feet to center at 94.3 mph.
“Kaz is swinging the bat well,” Schneider said. “Even the flyout to center on the breaking ball -- he’s kind of riding through some breaking balls, too, and really kind of squaring up the fastball.”

Okamoto’s hard work isn’t just in the batting cage, either. The infielder took the field early on Tuesday despite temperatures in the mid-90s in sunny West Sacramento, taking part in extra infield drills with third-base coach Carlos Febles.

On Tuesday, Okamoto’s glovework at the hot corner was considerably improved from a day earlier, when he committed two errors on the same rundown play in the first inning to bring in a run for the A’s.
“Mistakes happen, obviously,” Okamoto said. “I can’t change that, so all I can do is forget about it and focus on the next game and the next play.”

Okamoto couldn’t handle a pair of swinging bunts down the third-base line from A’s speedster Henry Bolte -- similar to the soft infield single from Max Muncy that kickstarted Monday’s A’s rally in the ninth -- but held his own at third. He made a nice backhanded stop on a grounder from Tommy White in the second inning, then ranged into foul ground to set his feet and throw out Alika Williams in the seventh.
“He works his tail off defensively,” Schneider said. “He’s turned into a pretty surehanded guy over there.”

It’s evident how much Okamoto wants to help the Blue Jays defend their 2025 AL pennant, and so far, he’s been perhaps their most productive hitter. Okamoto’s .762 OPS is tied with Alejandro Kirk for tops on the team among players with at least 100 plate appearances, and his 30 homers are far and away the most among Toronto hitters. George Springer is second with 14, and six-time All-Star Vladimir Guerrero Jr. has only eight.
That means it’s been Okamoto leading the charge, a role he seems to embrace even through the ups and downs he’s had throughout his standout rookie year.
“Right now, things are going well,” Okamoto said. “We only have a few more games here while we make a push for the postseason. Hopefully I can keep going.”
items.titleZh: Okamoto轰出第30轰，助蓝鸟保留季后赛希望
items.summaryZh: Okamoto轰出本季第30号本垒打，助蓝鸟以4比2击败运动家，保留冲击季后赛的希望。
bodyZh: 韦斯特萨克拉门托——周二在萨特健康公园以4比2击败运动家之后，Kazuma Okamoto在赛后接受采访时表达的信息非常明确：多伦多还没有放弃。
虽然Okamoto承认自己在一个出色的新秀赛季中实现了单季30支本垒打的个人目标，但他随即将重点转向了接下来关乎球队季后赛命运的16场关键常规赛。凭借周二的胜利，战绩为73胜73负的蓝鸟距离美国联盟最后一张季后赛门票仍有1场胜场差。
“能在第一年就达到30轰绝对是很棒的成就，但我们还有几场比赛要打，”Okamoto通过翻译Yusuke Oshima表示。“我想转换状态，专注于接下来的比赛。”

Okamoto在9月份确实状态火热，本月出战7场比赛，打击率达到.333（27打数9安打），OPS为1.009。继周一晚间在球队以5比6遭遇再见安打失利的比赛中轰出423英尺的阳春本垒打后，他在周二再次开轰，在第二局与Josh Smith先后敲出背靠背本垒打。这使他在2026年美联新秀本垒打榜上追平了芝加哥白袜内野手Munetaka Murakami，仅落后辛辛那提的Sal Stewart大联盟榜首1支本垒打。
凭借从运动家先发投手Jack Perkins手中敲出飞向左外野的阳春本垒打，Okamoto成为第10位在单赛季达到30轰里程碑的日本出生球员。大谷翔平曾6次做到这一点，Murakami在2026年达成，Seiya Suzuki上赛季打出32支本垒打，而Hideki Matsui则在2004年以31支本垒打开启了这一纪录。
“30轰是一个相当酷的里程碑，”蓝鸟总教练John Schneider说。“他加入了一个相当出色的日本球员名单。”
Okamoto能在MLB的第一个赛季就轰出30支本垒打或许并不让人意外：他在日本职棒读卖巨人队效力期间，从2018到2023年连续6个赛季打出这一成绩，在NPB生涯共累积了248支本垒打。
Okamoto在大联盟也曾经历过低谷——包括下半赛季的大部分时间——但近期他的状态回升令人鼓舞。Schneider提到了这位右打重炮在第九局的最后一次打席，当时Okamoto虽然没有完全打中好球带底部的滑球，但依然将球击飞了310英尺，击球初速达到每小时94.3英里。
“Kaz的挥棒感觉很好，”Schneider说。“甚至包括对决变化球打到中外野的飞球——他现在也能很好地应对各种变化球，并且真正能把速球击结实。”
Okamoto的努力不仅局限于打击笼内。周二阳光明媚的韦斯特萨克拉门托气温高达90多华氏度，这位内野手依然提前来到球场，与三垒教练Carlos Febles一起参加了额外的内野守备训练。
在周二的比赛中，Okamoto在三垒位置上的防守表现较前一天有了显著提升，他在周一第一局的同一次夹杀守备中曾出现两次失误，导致运动家得分。
“失误在所难免，”Okamoto说。“我无法改变过去，我能做的就是忘掉它，专注于下一场比赛和下一个守备。”
Okamoto虽然没能处理好运动家快腿Henry Bolte沿着三垒边线滚出的两记触击球——这类似于周一第九局Max Muncy吹起运动家反击号角的那个内野安打——但他在三垒守位上依然表现稳健。他在第二局美妙地反手拦下了Tommy White的滚地球，随后在第七局移动到界外区站定脚步，将球传出刺杀Alika Williams。
“他在防守端付出了百分之百的努力，”Schneider说。“他现在已经成长为一名相当稳健的防守球员。”
显而易见，Okamoto非常渴望帮助蓝鸟捍卫他们2025年的美联冠军荣誉，到目前为止，他或许是球队中最具产出的打者。在至少获得100个打席的球员中，Okamoto .762的OPS与Alejandro Kirk并列全队最高，而他30支本垒打的数据在多伦多打者中更是遥遥领先。George Springer以14支排名第二，6次入选全明星的Vladimir Guerrero Jr.则只有8支。
这意味着一直是Okamoto在率队前进，而在他出色的新秀赛季中，无论经历高潮还是低谷，他似乎都欣然接受了这一角色。
“目前一切进展顺利，”Okamoto说。“我们在向季后赛发起冲击的阶段只剩下最后几场比赛了。希望我能继续保持下去。”

items.titleEn: Giménez, Blue Jays feel the whiplash of almost-comeback win
bodyEn: WEST SACRAMENTO -- Andrés Giménez stood in the batter’s box as if frozen in place, keeping his bat extended and watching his game-tying ninth-inning home run in flight. He posed there for several seconds before jogging down the first-base line and flipping his bat end over end in front of a raucous Blue Jays dugout.

Just twenty minutes later, Giménez crouched to the left of the mound, stunned into silence. His all-out effort to field a bases-loaded chopper from Athletics first baseman Jeff McNeil hadn’t quite been enough: McNeil beat the rap at first base for a walk-off infield hit in the bottom of the ninth.
In a matter of moments, Giménez and the Blue Jays had experienced all the ups and downs of high-stakes, high-tension September baseball in Monday’s 6-5 loss at Sutter Health Park.

Giménez’s homer in the ninth to fully erase Toronto’s early 5-1 deficit looked like it might spark a dramatic comeback win. Instead, it just made things all the more painful -- especially since the Blue Jays had a chance to sneak back into an American League Wild Card spot thanks to the Guardians’ 6-4 loss to the Orioles earlier in the day.
“We’ve got to shake this one off and come back tomorrow,” Blue Jays manager John Schneider said.

It might not be easy for Toronto to bounce back from a game in which its ace and its lockdown closer both stumbled. Starter Dylan Cease was tagged for five runs (four earned) in five innings, while closer Louis Varland -- pitching in a tie game in the ninth -- failed to send the game to extra innings.

Varland’s struggles, at least, are more attributable to poor luck than to total ineffectiveness. Donovan Walton and Henry Bolte both drew walks to end plate appearances that featured a number of borderline pitches called balls. The Blue Jays, who lost both of their ABS challenges by the fourth inning, were powerless to change the outcome.

The Athletics’ hits against Varland in the ninth were hardly scorchers. Max Muncy led off the decisive frame by reaching on a 42.7 mph tapper to third base, while McNeil’s walk-off hit was all of 51.9 mph off the bat. Only one ball in the inning -- a line drive to center field for the second out -- even left the infield.
“It’s going to happen sometimes,” Schneider said. “No one else I’d rather have out there than Louis. Good placement by them.”
Cease, meanwhile, continued his struggles at Sutter Health Park. He allowed a career-high nine earned runs in his only previous start in West Sacramento, back in April 2025 with the Padres.
The right-hander’s average four-seam fastball velocity on Monday was just 94.9 mph, more than 2 mph below his season average of 97.1, but Cease expressed little concern for the sizable dip.
“I think it’s just late in the season,” Cease said. “I’ve got to kind of roll with what I’ve got and figure out how I can maybe maximize it a little better.”

Among the least effective pitchers in MLB when it comes to controlling the running game, Cease was repeatedly victimized on the basepaths during Monday’s start. The A’s swiped five bases in the first three innings, including two apiece for Henry Bolte and Zack Gelof, which led to two runs against Cease in the third. That brought Cease’s total to an MLB-high 31 stolen bases allowed this season.
“I wish I had a little more focus on that,” Cease said of the Athletics’ disruptive baserunning. “I feel like looking back, I kind of just let it happen. They definitely took advantage.”

Technically, the Blue Jays did manage to catch a runner stealing home in the first inning, but they didn’t get the out they needed. With men on the corners, Carlos Cortes broke for second, and Toronto catcher Alejandro Kirk caught Gelof off third, but a missed catch and then a poor throw from third baseman Kazuma Okamoto -- who was charged with two errors on the play -- ruined the rundown and brought in a second A’s run.

“We talked about it before the game: Against a pitcher like [Cease], they’re going to take chances,” Schneider said. “We’ve got to do a better job of limiting those extra bases. First inning, really, too, we’ve got to handle the baseball.”

Okamoto atoned for the mistake with a home run to lead off the Blue Jays’ three-run seventh inning, and Giménez made up for a baserunning gaffe of his own to bring Toronto level in the ninth, but ultimately, it wasn’t enough.
items.titleZh: Giménez与蓝鸟经历惊险逆转未果的过山车之战
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟在9局扳平比分却遭运动家再见安打，以5比6惜败。
bodyZh: WEST SACRAMENTO -- Andrés Giménez站在打击区上仿佛定格一般，保持着挥棒后的姿势，注视着他在第九局击出的扳平比分本垒打在空中飞翔。他在那里摆了几个动作好几秒钟，然后才慢跑奔向一垒，在喧闹的多伦多蓝鸟牛棚前把球棒在空中翻转。
仅仅二十分钟后，Giménez蹲在投手丘左侧，震惊得说不出话来。他全力去接运动家一垒手Jeff McNeil击出的满垒反弹球，但这还远远不够：McNeil险险跑过一垒，在九局下半打出了一支再见内场安打。
转瞬之间，Giménez和多伦多蓝鸟在周一于Sutter Health Park以5比6落败的比赛中，体验了九月高风险、高张力棒球的所有起起落落。
Giménez在第九局的本垒打彻底抹平了多伦多早先1比5的落后，这本可能点燃一场戏剧性的逆转胜利。然而，它却让事情变得更加痛苦——尤其是由于早些时候卫士以6比4输给金莺，蓝鸟本有机会悄然重返美国联盟外卡席位。
“我们必须忘掉这场比赛，明天卷土重来，”蓝鸟总教练John Schneider说道。
对于多伦多来说，要从王牌投手和稳固终结者双双失常的比赛中反弹，可能并不容易。先发投手Dylan Cease在五局投球中丢了5分（4分自责分），而终结者Louis Varland在第九局平局时登板，未能将比赛拖入延长局。
至少，Varland的挣扎更多归咎于运气不佳，而不是完全没有效力。Donovan Walton和Henry Bolte双双选到保送，结束了几个有着数个边缘球被判为坏球的打席。蓝鸟在第四局前输掉了两次ABS挑战，无力改变结果。
运动家在第九局对阵Varland的安打谈不上是强劲击球。Max Muncy以一支击球初速42.7英里的三垒方向小弹跳球开启了决定性的一局，而McNeil的再见安打击球初速也只有51.9英里。这一局中只有一颗球——一记飞向中外野的平飞球造成第二个出局数——甚至飞出了内场。
“这种事有时会发生，”Schneider说道，“我不希望换作其他人来投那一局，只有Louis。他们的落点找得很好。”
与此同时，Cease在Sutter Health Park延续了低迷表现。在2025年4月效力教士时，他在萨克拉门托西部的唯一一次先发中就曾丢过生涯新高的9分自责分。
这位右投周一的平均四缝线速球球速仅为94.9英里，比他97.1英里的赛季平均球速低了2英里多，但Cease对球速的大幅下降表示并不怎么担心。
“我想这只是因为赛季已经到了尾声，”Cease说道，“我必须顺其自然，看看如何能稍微更好地发挥出我的最大水平。”
作为MLB中在控制对手跑垒方面表现最差的投手之一，Cease在周一的先发中屡次在垒包上成为受害者。运动家在前三局盗了五个垒包，其中包括Henry Bolte和Zack Gelof各盗两个，这导致Cease在第三局丢了两分。这使得Cease本赛季被盗垒次数达到MLB最多的31次。
“我希望我对这方面能有更多专注，”Cease谈到运动家具有破坏性的跑垒时说道，“回想起来，我觉得我有点任由它发生了。他们确实利用了这一点。”
严格来说，蓝鸟在第一局确实成功抓到一个试图盗本垒的跑者，但他们没有拿到需要的出局数。在二三垒有人时，Carlos Cortes起跑试图盗二垒，多伦多捕手Alejandro Kirk将Gelof夹在三垒，但三垒手Kazuma Okamoto——他在该防守中被记两次失误——接球失误随后又传球糟糕，彻底毁了夹杀并送给运动家第二分。
“我们在赛前讨论过：面对像[Cease]这样的投手，他们会抓住机会，”Schneider说道，“我们必须在限制那些额外垒包方面做得更好。说实话，第一局我们也必须处理好球。”
Okamoto用一记本垒打弥补了此前的失误，拉开了蓝鸟第七局得到三分的序幕，而Giménez也弥补了他自己的跑垒失误，在第九局帮助多伦多扳平比分，但最终这还远远不够。

items.titleEn: Santander (torn labrum) to begin Triple-A rehab assignment
bodyEn: WEST SACRAMENTO -- A big bat is nearing a return to the Blue Jays. But will he be back by the end of the regular season?

Anthony Santander is set to begin a rehab assignment on Wednesday with Triple-A Buffalo, manager John Schneider announced before Monday’s series opener against the Athletics at Sutter Health Park. After undergoing surgery to repair a torn left shoulder labrum in February, Santander will begin working his way back to the Major Leagues.

The outfielder will need a lengthy, Spring Training-style ramp-up before rejoining Toronto, Schneider said. He will play his first rehab game as a designated hitter before getting reps in the outfield.

“It’ll be a handful of games, at least,” Schneider said of the assignment length. “We want to see how he’s feeling, how he’s hitting the ball. We’ll definitely be in touch with him once he gets rolling.”

When healthy, Santander could be a huge addition as a switch-hitting slugger with prodigious power: He crushed 44 homers for the Orioles during an All-Star 2024 campaign. But after signing a five-year, $92.5 million deal with the Blue Jays in January 2025, Santander was plagued by the shoulder injury throughout his first season in Toronto. He played just 54 regular-season games and batted just .175 with six home runs. Santander was a non-factor in the postseason, too, homering just once and posting a .564 OPS before being replaced on the roster midway through the ALCS.
After seeing no game action since mid-October, Santander might be a bit rusty in his initial appearances for the Bisons, but the Blue Jays won’t be pushing the panic button.
“He’s notoriously kind of a slow starter, too, so we want to make sure that he’s functioning at the normal level that he can,” Schneider said. “If he can help us, it’d be great.”

While Santander’s career platoon splits are practically even -- he has a .767 career OPS against left-handed pitchers, compared to a .761 mark against righties -- he struggled considerably against southpaws in limited action with the Blue Jays in 2025. Santander went 7-for-48 (.146) with no homers, 20 strikeouts and a .442 OPS against lefties in 2025.

Still, Schneider said, Toronto wants Santander to focus more on getting healthy than fine-tuning his approach against left-handers. The club’s message as Santander prepares to begin his rehab assignment? “Go be you.”
“I know last year was a little different based on the shoulder and how he was feeling,” Schneider said. “It’s kind of like, ‘Go get ’em.’”
items.titleZh: Santander（肩唇撕裂）将开始三藩市小联盟3A复健赛
items.summaryZh: Anthony Santander将开始小联盟3A复健赛，有望重回多伦多蓝鸟。
bodyZh: 西萨克拉门托——一名强打者即将重回多伦多蓝鸟阵中。但他能在常规赛结束前回归吗？
总教练John Schneider在周一于Sutter Health Park对阵运动家的系列赛开打前宣布，Anthony Santander将于周三在三藩市小联盟3A水牛城开始复健赛。在2月份接受左肩关节唇撕裂修复手术后，Santander将开始逐步重返大联盟。
Schneider表示，这位外野手在重新加入多伦多蓝鸟之前，需要进行类似于春训期间那样较长时间的逐步恢复。他将先以指定打击身份进行第一场复健赛，随后才会开始守外野。
“至少需要打几场比赛，”Schneider在谈到复健赛长度时说道。“我们想看看他的感觉如何，以及他击球的情况。一旦他进入状态，我们绝对会与他保持联系。”

当保持健康时，作为一名极具爆发力的左右开弓重炮手，Santander可能会成为球队的重要补强：他在2024年入选全明星赛的赛季里为巴尔的摩金莺轰出了44记本垒打。但在2025年1月与多伦多蓝鸟签下了一份为期5年、总额9250万美元的合同后，Santander在多伦多的第一个赛季饱受伤肩困扰。他只打了54场常规赛，打击率仅为.175，有6支本垒打。Santander在季后赛中也没有发挥作用，仅打出一支本垒打，OPS为.564，随后在美联冠军赛中途被移出名单。
由于自10月中旬以来就没有参加过比赛，Santander在为水牛城出战的初期可能会有些生疏，但多伦多蓝鸟不会因此而感到惊慌。
“众所周知，他也是个慢热型球员，所以我们要确保他能以正常的水平运转，”Schneider说道。“如果他能帮到我们，那就太好了。”
尽管Santander职业生涯对阵左投和右投的成绩相差无几——他生涯面对左投的OPS为.767，而面对右投为.761——但在2025年效力多伦多蓝鸟期间，他在有限的出场机会中面对左投时遇到了不小的麻烦。2025年对阵左投时，Santander在48个打数中仅敲出7支安打（打击率.146），没有本垒打，吞下20次三振，OPS为.442。
不过，Schneider表示，多伦多蓝鸟希望Santander更多地专注于恢复健康，而不是微调他面对左投时的进攻策略。在Santander准备开始复健赛之际，球队给他的信息是：“做回你自己。”
“我知道去年由于肩膀伤势以及他当时的身体感受，情况有些不同，”Schneider说道。“这就好比是，‘去大干一场吧。’”

items.titleEn: 'Totally different' Blue Jays ready for final push toward playoffs
bodyEn: This story was excerpted from Keegan Matheson's Blue Jays Beat newsletter. To read the full newsletter, click here. And subscribe to get it regularly in your inbox.
KANSAS CITY -- It’s all sitting right in front of the Blue Jays now.

This season has been wildly imperfect, filled with more frustrating days than fun ones, but none of that matters now. The Blue Jays are back to .500 at 72-72, just one game out of the final AL Wild Card spot, and they hold the tiebreaker over the team they’re chasing, the Guardians.

This team is still scrambling, but so is everyone else. Spencer Arrighetti was hit hard in Sunday’s finale in Kansas City, and at this point, the Blue Jays only have three starters pitching well in Dylan Cease, José Soriano and Max Scherzer.

They’ve been finding ways to make it work, though, at least relative to the rest of the AL Wild Card race. These aren’t powerhouse teams, but someone needs to claim that third spot, and the Blue Jays still feel like a team with momentum.

“We’re just playing good ball. Everybody’s got a hand in this,” Scherzer said over the weekend. “Starters, relievers, hitters, defense, you name it. The catchers are doing great. It takes a team effort to get wins in the big leagues and that’s what we’re doing. You’re seeing guys up and down the roster contribute here, and across the organization, too. Pitchers are coming up and down, we’re dealing with pitching injuries left and right, but guys have come in and plugged a hole. When you get that as an organization, you asked why we’re winning? That’s why we’re winning.”

At this point, the Blue Jays have nothing to lose. If they take big risks and whiff, then so be it. There seems to be a freedom with this club now, particularly after the Trade Deadline shook up a group that had grown stagnant.

“It just feels like we're going out there and playing,” All-Star second baseman Ernie Clement said. “Nobody's stressed out. Nobody's worried about their own personal stats. Everybody's just going out there and playing and trying to win, and that's when we're at our best. We're worried about one thing and one thing only, and that's winning.”
Remaining schedulesBlue Jays: at A’s, vs. Tigers, vs. Orioles, at Rangers, at Orioles, vs. RedsGuardians: at Orioles, at Twins, vs. White Sox, vs. A’s, at Red Sox, at Royals

The Rangers are still a factor, too, just a game behind the Blue Jays and already holding the tiebreaker, so that series later in the month is crucial. Even if the Orioles fade, they also have six games left against the Blue Jays to shake things up. There won’t be anything simple about this.
These don’t feel like the Blue Jays of June and July, though.

They have Brett Bateman batting leadoff with a .347 average, delivering value on that Kevin Gausman trade well ahead of schedule. Charles McAdoo has a legitimate role now, and the veterans have picked up, including streaks from Alejandro Kirk and George Springer. If Vladimir Guerrero Jr. can turn his recent momentum into something bigger, that changes everything.

“It’s totally different,” John Schneider said. “Different music, different people, different feel. It’s always fun to come to the ballpark with this group, but it’s nice to win, it’s nice to get on a bit of a roll. … Right now, we come to the park expecting to win and we’re not really budging from that.”
Everyone’s been feeling this and talking about it, from the loudest voices on the team right down to the strong, silent types.

“We’ve been winning, so the vibes are good,” Kazuma Okamoto said through interpreter Yusuke Oshima. “Even when we’re losing, I think we’re doing a good job of just flipping the page and making sure that on the next day, it’s a new game and a new day. We’re just bringing a positive mindset and that has been helping.”

It also feels like there’s finally been a shift away from grasping at 2025 and that identity, which may have been an external narrative more than anything the Blue Jays, themselves, actually believed in. These aren’t the ‘25 Blue Jays, but this isn’t the ‘25 postseason race.

Sneaking in with the third Wild Card spot would likely line the Blue Jays up against either the Astros or the White Sox. Both are solid enough teams, but there are no giants waiting for the Blue Jays. This team doesn’t just have a shot to slip in, they have a shot to go on a run, and it’s all up to them in these final 18 games.
items.titleZh: “截然不同”的多伦多蓝鸟准备向季后赛发起最后冲刺
items.summaryZh: 多伦多蓝鸟胜率重回五成，距离美联外卡仅差一场，正全力冲刺季后赛。
bodyZh: 本文摘自 Keegan Matheson 的 Blue Jays Beat 通讯。若要阅读完整讯息请点击此处，并可订阅以定期在收件箱中收到。
堪萨斯城讯——一切都摆在多伦多蓝鸟的眼前了。
这个赛季可以说是状况百出，充满了令人沮丧的日子远胜过欢乐的日子，但现在这些都不重要了。多伦多蓝鸟的战绩回到了 72 胜 72 负的五成胜率，距离美联最后一张外卡席位仅剩一场胜差，并且在与他们追赶的对手克利夫兰守护者交手时握有对战优势。
这支球队仍在奋力拼搏，但其他球队也是如此。Spencer Arrighetti 在周日于堪萨斯城的收官战中遭到痛击，就目前而言，多伦多蓝鸟只有 Dylan Cease、José Soriano 和 Max Scherzer 这三位先发投手投得比较出色。
不过，他们一直在设法让事情步入正轨，至少在与其他美联外卡竞争对手相比时是如此。这些并不是什么超级强队，但总得有人拿下第三个席位，而多伦多蓝鸟依然是一支带有气势的球队。

“我们只是在打好比赛。每个人都参与其中，”Max Scherzer 周末时表示，“先发投手、后援投手、打者、防守，应有尽有。捕手们表现得非常伟大。在大联盟要赢得比赛需要团队的共同努力，而这正是我们正在做的事。你会看到阵容上上下下的球员都在这里以及整个球团中做出贡献。投手们不断上下异动，我们左右逢源地应对着投手伤病，但球员们挺身而出填补了空缺。当你作为一个球团拥有这样的情况时，你问我们为什么能赢？这就是我们取胜的原因。”
到了这个阶段，多伦多蓝鸟已经没有什么好失去的了。如果他们冒大险却落空，那就顺其自然吧。这支俱乐部现在似乎有一种自由感，特别是经历过交易截止日重组了一支原本已经停滞不前的阵容之后。
“感觉我们就是上场去比赛，”全明星二垒手 Ernie Clement 表示，“没有人感到压力。没有人去担心自己的个人数据。大家就是上场比赛并试图赢球，这才是我们表现最好的时候。我们只担心一件事，而且是唯一的一件事，那就是赢球。”
剩余赛程多伦多蓝鸟：对阵运动家（客场）、对阵底特律老虎（主场）、对阵巴尔的摩金莺（主场）、对阵得克萨斯游骑兵（客场）、对阵巴尔的摩金莺（客场）、对阵辛辛那提红人（主场）克利夫兰守护者：对阵巴尔的摩金莺（客场）、对阵明尼苏达双城（客场）、对阵芝加哥白袜（主场）、对阵运动家（主场）、对阵波士顿红袜（客场）、对阵堪萨斯城皇家（客场）
得克萨斯游骑兵也是一个因素，他们仅落后多伦多蓝鸟一场胜差且已握有对战优势，因此本月稍后的系列赛至关重要。即使巴尔的摩金莺状态下滑，他们也还剩六场与多伦多蓝鸟的比赛来搅乱局势。这一切绝不会简单。
不过，这感觉不像是六月和七月的多伦多蓝鸟。
他们让 Brett Bateman 打第一棒并缴出 .347 的打击率，提前展现了交易 Kevin Gausman 的价值。Charles McAdoo 现在扮演了合法的角色，老将们也找回了状态，包括 Alejandro Kirk 和 George Springer 的连续安打表现。如果 Vladimir Guerrero Jr. 能把最近的势头转化为更大成果，那将改变一切。
“这截然不同，”John Schneider 表示，“不同的音乐，不同的人，不同的感觉。带着这群人来到球场总是很有趣，但赢球的感觉真好，打出一波连胜的感觉真好……目前，我们来到球场就期待着赢球，而且我们真的不会改变这种想法。”
每个人都感受到了这一点并在谈论它，从队里最大声的球员到那些坚强而沉默的球员皆是如此。
“我们一直在赢球，所以氛围很好，”Kazuma Okamoto 透过翻译 Yusuke Oshima 表示，“即使在输球的时候，我认为我们也很擅长翻过这一页，确保第二天就是一场新比赛、新的一天。我们只是保持积极的心态，这很有帮助。”
这也让人感觉终于从对 2025 年及其球队认同的执念中走了出来，这或许更多是外界的叙事，而不是多伦多蓝鸟自己真正相信的东西。这些不是 2025 年的多伦多蓝鸟，但这不是 2025 年的季后赛争夺战。
以第三张外卡席位悄悄晋级，很可能会让多伦多蓝鸟对阵休斯敦太空人或芝加哥白袜。两支球队都足够扎实，但并没有巨人在等待着多伦多蓝鸟。这支球队不仅有机会挤进去，还有机会打出一波连胜，而在接下来的最后 18 场比赛中，一切都掌握在他们自己手中。

items.titleEn: Blue Jays unable to sweep, lose WC ground despite encouraging series
bodyEn: KANSAS CITY -- If the Blue Jays can reel off six more series like this to end the season, they’re headed to the postseason, but they couldn’t stick the landing for a sweep. ​

Sunday’s 6-1 loss to the Royals nudged the Blue Jays back to .500 and one game out of the final AL Wild Card spot, which now belongs to the Guardians again. The Blue Jays just beat those same Guardians and hold the season tiebreaker (4-2), but Cleveland has three walk-offs in their past three days.
This is what mattered most from Sunday in Kansas City:
1. Blue Jays still need more from Spencer Arrighetti
We can consider Arrighetti to be stretched all the way back out to a “starter” at this point, after throwing 91 pitches over 4 2/3 innings. Now, the Blue Jays need some quality out of those innings.

Arrighetti got rocked in the first, allowing a bunt single and walk to snowball when he served up a three-run shot to Vinnie Pasquantino. Salvador Perez later took him deep, too, and while Arrighetti allowed six runs, that number could have been even higher with all of the warning-track shots he gave up.

Better outings from Arrighetti aren’t a “want” for the Blue Jays, they’re a need. With Jameson Taillon back on the Blue Jays’ crowded IL, they’re stuck using a bullpen day as their No. 5 starter, which makes Arrighetti the No. 4. There’s no skipping him, but next time through, the Blue Jays may consider using an opener in front of Arrighetti.
2. The Adventures of Jesús Sánchez
How much longer can the Blue Jays run the risk of Jesús Sánchez roaming the outfield?

Sunday brought another glaring error when Sánchez dropped a simple fly ball in the second inning, which extended the inning for Arrighetti and cost him five more pitches. The odd blunder is excusable over 162 games, but these have become too common for Sánchez.

Out of 146 qualified outfielders, Sánchez is near the bottom with a -8 Fielding Run Value, metrically the weakest defender on a team that’s otherwise been among baseball’s best. This is actually a bit surprising for Sánchez, who had typically been closer to a league-average defender before being traded to the Blue Jays. This season, with a combination of physical and mental errors, it’s just not working.

The alternative is to have Myles Straw in left field, trading some offensive upside for much stronger defense and better speed. Given that the Blue Jays still profile as a lower-scoring team needing to win some tight games down the stretch, Straw makes a lot of sense in these spots. It could also leave the Blue Jays more willing to roll the dice on Sean Keys, who played just a handful of games in left field in Triple-A, but offers greater power upside than Sánchez and should be able to at least meet his 2026 standard defensively.
3. One bright spot: Josh Smith

Quietly, Smith has been one of the Blue Jays’ hottest hitters lately. His home run Sunday was his fourth in 18 games with the organization, too, a welcome sign in a lineup looking for a spark each night.
The Smith deal wasn’t the flashiest move of the Trade Deadline, coming over from the Rangers for lefty Adam Macko, but it’s working.

“When we acquired him, it was under the radar,” manager John Schneider said. “We still think he’s a good player who was having a down year. There are some things, mechanically, for him to get back to. He was aware of that, too. … He made some pretty quick adjustments.”

Immediately, Smith identified a disconnect between his upper and lower half. With that wrinkle smoothed out again, he’s unlocking better bat speed, and if he keeps hitting like this, he could force his way into the lineup more often down the stretch.
items.titleZh: 多伦多蓝鸟未能完成横扫，系列赛虽有积极一面但外卡排名下滑
items.summaryZh: 多伦多蓝鸟周日以1-6不敌堪萨斯城皇家，胜率回到五成，在美联外卡竞争中落后。
bodyZh: 堪萨斯城讯——如果多伦多蓝鸟能在赛季末再复制六次这样的系列赛，他们就能杀入季后赛，但他们没能在最后一场比赛中完成横扫。
周日以1-6不敌堪萨斯城的比赛，让多伦多蓝鸟的胜率回到了五成，距离美联最后一张外卡席位差了1场比赛，该席位目前重新回到了克利夫兰守护者手中。多伦多蓝鸟刚刚击败了这支守护者，并手握赛季交手优势（4-2），但克利夫兰在过去三天里取得了三场再见安打。
以下是周日在堪萨斯城比赛中最重要的一些看点：
1. 多伦多蓝鸟仍需要Spencer Arrighetti提供更多贡献
在投了4又2/3局共91球之后，我们现在可以认为Spencer Arrighetti的投球局数已经完全恢复到了“先发投手”的标准。接下来，多伦多蓝鸟需要从这些局数中得到高质量的投球。
Spencer Arrighetti在第一局就遭到重创，在被敲出触击安打和保送后形势恶化，随后被Vinnie Pasquantino轰出一记三分本垒打。随后Salvador Perez也从他手中轰出本垒打，尽管Spencer Arrighetti丢了六分，但考虑到他投出的那些落在警戒区前的飞球，失分本可能更高。
Spencer Arrighetti投出更精彩的比赛对多伦多蓝鸟来说不是“想要”，而是“必需”。随着Jameson Taillon再次进入多伦多蓝鸟拥挤的伤病名单，他们被迫在第五先发的位置上使用牛棚车轮战，这使得Spencer Arrighetti成为了第四先发。无法跳过他的轮次，但在下一次登场时，多伦多蓝鸟可能会考虑在Spencer Arrighetti之前使用假先发（opener）。
2. Jesús Sánchez的惊险时刻
多伦多蓝鸟还能承担让Jesús Sánchez镇守外野的风险多久？
周日的比赛再次出现了明显的失误：Jesús Sánchez在第二局漏掉了一个简单的飞球，这延长了Spencer Arrighetti的投球局数并多消耗了他5个球。在漫长的162场比赛中，偶尔的失误是可以原谅的，但这些对Jesús Sánchez来说已经变得太常见了。
在146名合格的外野手中，Jesús Sánchez以-8的防守跑动价值（Fielding Run Value）排在垫底位置，从数据上看，他是这支原本防守堪称全联盟最佳之一的球队中防守最薄弱的球员。这其实对Jesús Sánchez来说有点令人意外，在被交易到多伦多蓝鸟之前，他的防守水平通常接近联盟平均水准。本赛季，由于身体和心理层面的失误交织在一起，情况就是不尽如人意。

备选方案是让Myles Straw出任左外野手，牺牲一些进攻上限以换取更强的防守和更好的速度。鉴于多伦多蓝鸟仍然是一支得分较低、需要在冲刺阶段靠赢下胶着比赛取胜的球队，Myles Straw在这些位置上显得非常合理。这或许也会让多伦多蓝鸟更愿意在Sean Keys身上冒险，他在小联盟三A只在左外野打了几场比赛，但比起Jesús Sánchez拥有更高的长打潜力，并且防守端至少应该能达到2026年的标准。
3. 一个亮点：Josh Smith
悄然之间，Josh Smith成为了多伦多蓝鸟近期状态最火热的打者之一。他在周日轰出的本垒打是他在该队效力18场比赛中的第四支本垒打，这对于一支每天都在寻找火花的打线来说是一个受欢迎的信号。
引进Josh Smith并不是交易截止日最轰动的运作，他是用左投Adam Macko从得克萨斯游骑兵换来的，但这个交易正在发挥作用。
“当我们得到他时，这是一次低调的运作，”主教练John Schneider说，“我们仍然认为他是一名正经历低迷期的优秀球员。他的挥棒机制有一些需要恢复的地方。他自己也很清楚这一点……他做出了一些相当迅速的调整。”
Josh Smith迅速找出了自己上半身和下半身脱节的问题。随着这个瑕疵再次被抚平，他释放出了更好的挥棒速度，如果他能继续这样保持打击火力，他可能会在冲刺阶段迫使自己更频繁地进入首发阵容。
items.author: Keegan Matheson

items.titleEn: Okamoto's career-high 4-hit night fuels Blue Jays' burst above .500
bodyEn: KANSAS CITY -- Can you believe it? The Blue Jays, just 19 games from the finish line, own the final postseason spot in the American League.

Saturday’s 4-3 win over the Royals moved the Blue Jays into a tie for the final AL Wild Card spot with the Guardians, but they hold that tiebreaker based on their head-to-head record this season (4-2).

The win also moved the Blue Jays to 72-71. Yes, the number on the left is finally bigger than the one on the right. For the first time since April 3, when the Blue Jays were 4-3, they’re back above .500.
“Feels like it’s been a while, but I love the way we’re playing,” manager John Schneider said. “Love the way we’re being resilient. We struck first, got punched back in the mouth and stayed on it.”
This is what mattered most:
1. Kazuma Okamoto: The complete package
This may have been the best night of Okamoto’s big league career, his first four-hit performance with two runs driven in.

Okamoto did it all, from his classics to some new material. There were two doubles, including one ripped just inches inside the third-base line, and that’s what we’re used to seeing from Okamoto. Everything he hits is hard, and just about everything he hits is yanked to the left side of the diamond. Oddly enough, though, Okamoto’s most impressive swing of the night may have been the sixth-inning single, which he shot out to right-center field, which is rare territory for the Japanese slugger.

Okamoto’s game is built on highs and lows. On one hand, he’s struck out 167 times, just three shy of the Blue Jays’ all-time franchise record shared by Jose Bautista (2017) and Matt Chapman (‘22). The trade-off has been Okamoto’s power, though, with 28 home runs.

“There have been some ups and downs,” Okamoto said through interpreter Yusuke Oshima. “I know my weaknesses, but I’m always working to make sure that I can hit the ones I’m having a hard time hitting.”

Okamoto cannot be turned into a contact hitter, and thankfully, the Blue Jays haven’t whispered that idea. They’ve let him lean into his incredible natural power, and while everyone involved understands that will come with some empty at-bats in between, Saturday showed us the next level of Okamoto. When he’s at his best, Okamoto isn’t just a complementary power bat, he can change games.
“We’ve come this far, so all we can do is win and hopefully go to the postseason,” Okamoto said. “That’s all we’re thinking about. Every game, we’re giving it our all.”
2. Max Scherzer keeps the fight alive

All the Blue Jays needed from Scherzer was “enough,” and that’s exactly what he gave them. Allowing just three runs over 5 2/3 innings, Scherzer kept the Blue Jays in the game just long enough and gave the bullpen just enough help -- another solid day from the 42-year-old.

“I feel great. My body’s really responding. I’m getting stronger every outing and I’m executing better,” Scherzer said. “Outside of the first inning, I felt like I did a pretty good job. Let’s keep this going. I feel healthy, I feel good, everything’s in a good spot. Keep it going.”

Scherzer’s late-season run is one of the best stories we’ve seen this season. Now past his thumb, forearm, ankle and back issues, Scherzer is helping keep this rotation together with Dylan Cease and José Soriano as the only other healthy, full-length starters.
From there? It’s scramble mode, but the Blue Jays don’t want to mess with Scherzer’s schedule.
“As of now, we’re trying to keep Max where he is and have him go after the [Thursday] off-day,” Schneider said. “We’ll cross that bridge after we get through tomorrow.”
3. The path forward: Going for the sweep
It’s scoreboard-watching season, and starter Spencer Arrighetti will try to lead the Blue Jays to a sweep against Randy Dobnak in Sunday's finale.

If you’re a Blue Jays fan, you’ll spend one more day pretending to be a Red Sox fan, where lefty Payton Tolle takes on the Orioles. The Blue Jays and Orioles still have six games against one another, so it’s important that the Blue Jays create a bit of a gap there to eliminate the risk of a run.
The Guardians, though, have Gavin Williams, who mowed down 13 Blue Jays batters this past Tuesday, so the AL Wild Card rival is positioned well against the Tigers.
items.titleZh: Kazuma Okamoto单场4安创生涯新高，助多伦多蓝鸟胜率重返五成
items.summaryZh: 多伦多蓝鸟击败堪萨斯城皇家，胜率自4月以来首次重返五成，并暂居美联外卡席位。
bodyZh: 堪萨斯城讯 —— 你敢相信吗？距离赛季结束还剩19场比赛，多伦多蓝鸟目前占据着美国联盟的最后一个季后赛席位。
周六以4比3战胜堪萨斯城皇家后，多伦多蓝鸟在美联最后一张外卡席位上追平了克利夫兰守护者，并且凭借本赛季的交手记录优势（4胜2负）占据优势。
这场胜利也让多伦多蓝鸟的战绩来到72胜71负。是的，左边的数字终于比右边的数字大了。自4月3日多伦多蓝鸟战绩为4胜3负以来，他们的胜率首次重返五成以上。
“感觉已经过去很久了，但我很喜欢我们现在的比赛方式，”总教练John Schneider表示，“喜欢我们展现出的韧性。我们率先出击，虽然遭到对手反击，但我们顶住了压力。”
以下是最为关键的几点：
1. Kazuma Okamoto：攻守兼备的全能表现
这或许是Kazuma Okamoto大联盟生涯中最精彩的一个夜晚，他首次单场敲出4支安打并贡献2分打点。
Kazuma Okamoto展现了全面身手，既有招牌表现，也有新的亮点。其中包括两支二垒安打，有一支是沿着三垒边线险险落地的强袭球，这也是我们熟悉的Kazuma Okamoto。他击出的每一球都极具力量，且几乎全都拉打到内野左侧。不过奇怪的是，Kazuma Okamoto当晚让人印象最深刻的挥击，或许是他在第六局击出的右中外野安打，这对于这位日本强打者来说并不多见。
Kazuma Okamoto的比赛风格伴随着高潮与低谷。一方面，他已经吞下167次三振，距离Jose Bautista（2017年）和Matt Chapman（2022年）共同保持的多伦多蓝鸟队史纪录仅差3次。不过，代价是Kazuma Okamoto展现出了28支本垒打的强大火力。
“中间经历了一些起伏，”Kazuma Okamoto通过翻译Yusuke Oshima表示，“我很清楚自己的弱点，但我一直在努力确保自己能够打好那些我不太容易应付的球。”
Kazuma Okamoto不可能被改造为安打型打者，谢天谢地，多伦多蓝鸟也没有产生过这种念头。他们让他尽情发挥惊人的天赋力量，虽然所有相关人员都明白这难免伴随着一些空三振，但周六的比赛让我们看到了更高层次的Kazuma Okamoto。当他处于最佳状态时，Kazuma Okamoto不仅仅是一个辅助型的重炮手，他能够改变比赛。
“我们已经走到了这一步，所以我们能做的就是赢球，并希望能打进季后赛，”Kazuma Okamoto说道，“这就是我们脑子里想的全部事情。每一场比赛，我们都在全力以赴。”
2. Max Scherzer延续战斗力
多伦多蓝鸟对Max Scherzer的要求只是“足够好”，而他完美地做到了。在投完5又2/3局仅失3分后，Max Scherzer让多伦多蓝鸟留在比赛中，并为牛棚提供了足够的支持——这位42岁的老将又交出了一场稳健的投球。
“我感觉很好。我的身体反应很棒。每一次登板我都感觉更强壮，执行力也更好了，”Max Scherzer说道，“除了第一局，我觉得自己做得相当不错。让我们把这种状态保持下去。我感觉很健康，感觉很好，一切都在正确的轨道上。继续保持。”
Max Scherzer在赛季末段的爆发是本赛季最精彩的故事之一。在摆脱了拇指、前臂、脚踝和背部伤势后，Max Scherzer与Dylan Cease以及José Soriano成为先发轮值中仅有的保持健康、能够吃满局数的投手，帮助球队稳住阵脚。
接下来呢？虽然处于艰难应变的状态，但多伦多蓝鸟并不想打乱Max Scherzer的投球节奏。
“目前，我们正试图让Max留在既定位置，让他在[周四]休息日之后登板，”Schneider说道，“等我们过了明天再来考虑那一步。”
3. 前进之路：力争横扫
现在是关注记分牌的季节，先发投手Spencer Arrighetti将在周日的收官战中力争带领多伦多蓝鸟横扫Randy Dobnak领衔的对手。
如果你是一名多伦多蓝鸟球迷，你还得再假装一天波士顿红袜球迷，届时左投Payton Tolle将对阵巴尔的摩金莺。多伦多蓝鸟和巴尔的摩金莺之间还有六场比赛要打，因此多伦多蓝鸟拉开一定差距以消除潜在风险至关重要。
不过，克利夫兰守护者拥有Gavin Williams，他在上周二三振了13名多伦多蓝鸟打者，这位美联外卡竞争对手对阵底特律老虎时占据着有利位置。

items.titleEn: Taillon (right elbow inflammation) back on injured list
bodyEn: KANSAS CITY -- Jameson Taillon left Friday night’s start with right elbow discomfort, another setback just two innings into his first start back from the 15-day IL.

Taillon had been down with right forearm tendinitis, but he and the Blue Jays felt they’d caught that early, and he felt comfortable through a Triple-A rehab start before coming back to the big leagues. After just 29 pitches Friday night, though, John Schneider came out of the dugout to speak to the umpiring crew between innings while the bullpen quickly began to stir.
Taillon is now headed for an MRI after the Blue Jays’ 9-2 win over the Royals, and the club should have more information on Taillon this weekend.

“He said it felt a bit more nerve-y, if that makes sense,” John Schneider said. “He’s been through this a little bit and he said this felt a little bit different than the previous injury, so we’ll just see what the MRI says.”

This is a troubling blow to Taillon, the well-liked right-hander who is now in his 10th MLB season. After Taillon was designated for assignment by the Cubs just over a month ago, he was traded to the Blue Jays and immediately profiled as a rotation fill-in following the trade of Kevin Gausman. That hasn’t happened, though, and with so many injuries elsewhere in this rotation, the Blue Jays are back to scrambling.
Where does the rotation stand?

Dylan Cease is going to pitch every fifth day down the stretch, and with off-days each of the next three Thursdays, the Blue Jays can pull that off to maximize their ace’s value. The same could go for José Soriano, too, and if Max Scherzer feels strong, keep the trio rolling.

Beyond that, it’s messy. The Blue Jays have long been without José Berríos (Tommy John) and Cody Ponce (ACL). Even Bowden Francis (Tommy John) would have seen plenty of starts by now, but he was lost for the season. Shane Bieber is on the IL with right teres major inflammation, and Trey Yesavage underwent surgery to repair the meniscus in his left knee, but is chasing a comeback by the end of the regular season.

The result? Sunday’s finale against the Royals is already lined up as a bullpen day with Spencer Arrighetti as the “bulk guy”, either starting or following an opener. That was a fine enough plan for one spot in the rotation, but if the Blue Jays have two up in the air, this bullpen -- which is already running on fumes -- will be asked to carry the team.
The latest on Trey Yesavage
The Taillon news makes Yesavage’s timeline even more important.
The 23-year-old threw 23 pitches in a bullpen session Friday at the club’s complex in Dunedin, Fla., and felt fine. He was up to 92 mph in that session and is scheduled to throw another on Monday.

If all goes well, the Blue Jays would then get Yesavage on the mound facing some hitters at the complex on Thursday, simulating roughly two innings. It’s possible he pitches in a Minor League rehab game after that or continues to face hitters in a more controlled environment at the complex, but either way, it’s beginning to feel like Yesavage has a real shot to come back and help, even if he’d be pitching in shorter bursts.
items.titleZh: Taillon（右肘发炎）再次进入伤病名单
items.summaryZh: Jameson Taillon因右肘不适再度进入伤病名单，多伦多蓝鸟先发轮值面临严峻考验。
bodyZh: 堪萨斯城——Jameson Taillon在周五晚上的先发中因右肘不适提前退场，在他从15天伤病名单复出的首场比赛仅投了两局后，这又是一次挫折。
Taillon此前曾因右前臂肌腱炎缺阵，但他与多伦多蓝鸟都认为发现得早，在重返大联盟之前，他在小联盟复健赛中感觉一切正常。然而，在周五晚上仅投了29球后，John Schneider便在局间从休息区走出来与裁判组交谈，而牛棚则迅速开始热身。
在多伦多蓝鸟以9-2击败堪萨斯城皇家之后，Taillon接下来将接受核磁共振检查，俱乐部预计将在本周末获得关于Taillon的更多信息。
“他说感觉更像是神经方面的问题，如果这可以理解的话，”John Schneider说道，“他经历过这些，并且他说这次感觉和之前的伤势有些不同，所以我们得看看核磁共振的结果怎么说。”
这对现年已进入第10个大联盟赛季、备受喜爱的右投手Taillon来说是一个令人担忧的打击。就在一个多月前被芝加哥小熊指定为指定球员后，Taillon被交易到了多伦多蓝鸟，在Kevin Gausman被交易后，他立刻被视为轮值的替补人选。然而，这种情况并未发生，随着轮值中其他地方出现如此多的伤病，多伦多蓝鸟再次陷入了焦头烂额的境地。
目前的先发轮值情况如何？
Dylan Cease将在赛季冲刺阶段每五天登板一次，随着接下来的三个周四都有休息日，多伦多蓝鸟可以做到这一点，以最大化他们王牌投手的价值。José Soriano也可以如法炮制，如果Max Scherzer感觉身体强健，那就让这三人继续轮转。
除此之外，情况一团糟。多伦多蓝鸟长期缺少José Berríos（手肘韧带置换手术）和Cody Ponce（前十字韧带）。甚至Bowden Francis（手肘韧带置换手术）本该已经投了很多场先发，但他赛季报销。Shane Bieber因右大圆肌发炎而进入伤病名单，Trey Yesavage接受了左膝半月板修复手术，但正争取在常规赛结束前复出。
结果如何？对阵皇家队的周日收官战已经安排为牛棚车轮战，由Spencer Arrighetti担任“长中继”，要么直接先发，要么在假先发之后登板。对于轮值中的某一个空缺来说，这还是个不错的计划，但如果多伦多蓝鸟有两个位置悬而未决，这个已经精疲力竭的牛棚将被要求扛起球队。
关于Trey Yesavage的最新动态
Taillon的消息让Yesavage的时间表变得更加重要。
这位23岁的球员周五在俱乐部位于佛罗里达州达尼din的训练基地进行了一场牛棚投球训练，投了23球，感觉良好。他在那次训练中的球速达到了92英里/小时，并计划于周一进行另一次投球训练。
如果一切顺利，多伦多蓝鸟随后将安排Yesavage周四在基地面对一些打者登板，模拟大约两局的投球。此后他有可能在小联盟复健赛中登板，或者继续在基地受控的环境中面对打者，但无论如何，人们开始觉得Yesavage确实有复出并提供帮助的机会，即使他会以较短的局数登板投球。
